title: Design: Long and unusual payer names fit the Bill Invoices To line
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, a payer, with a long name with spaces that no other customer has, at least 60 characters (for example Northern Plains Heavy Truck and Trailer Repair Services West).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, a payer, whose name is customer A's name with every space taken out (for example NorthernPlainsHeavyTruckandTrailerRepairServicesWest).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, a payer, with a name that no other customer has and that includes each of the characters & " ' < > (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Parts> & Sons).
  • If a name field stops before the end of a name, use the longest name it takes.
  • Have three new customers for this test, customer D, customer E and customer F, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer A, customer B and customer C in turn (in Edit Customer).
  • Open the attached picture bt-p1-12-after-bill-invoices-to-line.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer D's page.
  2. Open customer E's page.
  3. Open customer F's page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Under IBS on the left card, "Bill Invoices To" shows customer A's name, with "Change" under it.
  • Customer A's name stays inside the card: no part of it runs past the card's right edge or covers "Change".
  • The Contacts and Assets counters below are fully visible.

Step 2:

  • "Bill Invoices To" shows customer B's name, with "Change" under it.
  • Customer B's name stays inside the card: no part of it runs past the card's right edge or covers "Change".
  • The Contacts and Assets counters below are fully visible.

Step 3:

  • "Bill Invoices To" shows customer C's name, with "Change" under it.
  • Customer C's name shows exactly as saved: the & " ' < > characters appear as typed, not changed into other characters or codes.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • S1-R1: “When a default other than the customer itself is saved, the customer page left card shows "Bill Invoices To" with the payer's name.”
  • S1-R2: “Users who may set the default see "Change" beside the name; it opens the "Bill Invoices To" window.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794510417-a68d (its boards are byte-identical to version 1794239066-4906 read 9 Nov 2026), read 13 Nov 2026: pictures "Bill Invoices To line" (page 1 "Set a customer's default Bill To", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p1-12-after-bill-invoices-to-line.png

The design's own words:

  • “Under IBS: "Bill Invoices To", "A & J Truck & Trailer Repair", and "Change".”

The design draws this place with ordinary names only; it draws no long name without spaces and no name with & " ' < >. The stress check follows the design-case checklist (lesson L-21); the expected words come from the PRD quotes above.
